settings.text: A signed Cartier bracelet or Van Cleef pendant is more than jewelry — it's a piece of a house's history. It's also exactly what counterfeiters imitate most. That's why every pre-owned maison piece we sell passes through the same authentication process before it ever reaches the site.

settings.title: Hallmarks & Serial Numbers
settings.text: Maker's marks, metal hallmarks and serial numbers are verified against each maison's known conventions for the period.

settings.title: Construction & Materials
settings.text: Our specialists examine clasps, hinges, settings and stone quality — the details houses never compromise on and imitations always do.

settings.title: Provenance & Papers
settings.text: Where original boxes, certificates or service records exist, they're documented and included. Where they don't, our own authentication documentation ships with the piece.

Signed estate pieces hold their value, carry designs the houses no longer make, and arrive with a patina no new piece can imitate. Bought well — and authenticated properly — they are among the smartest purchases in fine jewelry.

settings.title: Estate Authentication
settings.intro: Every estate piece we offer is examined, verified and documented before it's listed. Here's what that actually means.
